title: Formal completion morphisms as compatible infinitesimal restriction families
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a finite type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For $n\geq0$ put $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ [def-pc-base-change], and let $j_n:X_n\to X$ and $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ be the canonical maps, with $i_n$ specified by both projections. Write $c_n:i_n^*j_{n+1}^*\cong j_n^*$ for the canonical tensor-pullback comparison induced by $i_nj_{n+1}=j_n$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $F,G$ be coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent] and set $K=I\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. There exists an equivalence of sets from the natural transformations between the formal completion inverse systems $(G/K^{n+1}G)_n$ and $(F/K^{n+1}F)_n$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] to the set of families $v_n:j_n^*G\to j_n^*F$ satisfying $v_n\circ c_{n,G}=c_{n,F}\circ i_n^*v_{n+1}$ for every $n\geq0$. For each $w:G\to F$ the equivalence takes the induced morphism of quotient systems to $(j_n^*w)_n$. This identifies two formal Hom sets and asserts no lifting to $\operatorname{Hom}_X(G,F)$.

proof.text: Apply the thickening-systems dictionary to f and I, choosing the tensor-pullback adjunctions. Obtain R, Φ, their evaluation comparisons r_n, and ρ:completion≅R⋙Φ. Since Φ is an equivalence, conjugation by ρ gives a bijection from Hom(RG,RF) to the formal Hom set. Forgetting the coherent condition identifies that formal Hom set with natural transformations between formalCompletionSystem(I O_X,G) and formalCompletionSystem(I O_X,F).

Conjugate each component of a system arrow by r_n. The comparison equation for r_n identifies its system compatibility with the family compatibility for the dictionary comparison c′_n. The inverse conjugations reconstruct the system arrow, hence this is a bijection.

The family condition is independent of the natural comparison chosen between i_n^*j_{n+1}^* and j_n^*. Indeed j_n is a closed immersion by the dictionary, so its pushforward is fully faithful. For its pullback L and pushforward R, the counit is invertible and L(unit) is invertible by the triangle identity. Any natural automorphism α of L extends to a natural automorphism on the target category by counit conjugation of α_R. Naturality against the unit identifies its component at LF with α_F. Thus α_G≫v=v≫α_F for every map v:LG→LF. Apply this to the difference of the two comparisons and cancel α. In particular it identifies compatibility for c′_n with compatibility for the specified c_n.

Compose the inverse of the formal-Hom bijection with the componentwise-family bijection to get e. Naturality of ρ and r_n identifies e(formalCompletionMap w) with the family of tensor-pullback maps of w. The subtype proof follows from naturality of c_n. These arguments use only finite type over a Noetherian base, not completeness, separatedness or a proper closed support.
